PRENATAL GENETIC TESTING REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center
Department of Clinical Genetics

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Medical Record Number: [redacted ID]
Referring Physician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date of Collection: [redacted date]
Date of Report: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Prenatal testing requested for screening of common chromosomal abnormalities

SPECIMEN TYPE
Chorionic villi sample (uncultured)

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)
Rapid aneuploidy screening for chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X and Y

METHODOLOGY
DNA was extracted from uncultured chorionic villi. QF-PCR analysis was performed using fluorescently labeled primers for short tandem repeat (STR) markers on chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X and Y. A minimum of 4 informative markers were analyzed per chromosome. Peak area ratios were calculated to determine chromosome copy number.

RESULTS

Chromosome 13: NORMAL
Informative markers: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S305
All markers show normal biallelic patterns

Chromosome 18: NORMAL
Informative markers: D18S391, D18S390, D18S535, D18S386
All markers show normal biallelic patterns

Chromosome 21: NORMAL
Informative markers: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1446
All markers show normal biallelic patterns

Sex Chromosomes: XY (NORMAL MALE)
AMELOGENIN: XY pattern detected
X chromosome markers: DXS6809, DXS6803, HPRT - normal patterns
Y chromosome markers: SRY, DYS448 - present

INTERPRETATION
QF-PCR analysis is consistent with a normal chromosome complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. Sex chromosome analysis indicates a normal male karyotype (XY). No evidence of trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), or trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) was detected.

LIMITATIONS
This test screens only for common aneuploidies of chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X and Y. Other chromosomal abnormalities, mosaicism below 20%, structural rearrangements, and single gene disorders are not detected by this method.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Full karyotype analysis from cultured chorionic villi to follow. This will provide comprehensive cytogenetic evaluation of all chromosomes and detect structural abnormalities not identified by QF-PCR.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD
Laboratory Director: Dr. [redacted name], MD, PhD
CAP Accredited Laboratory #[redacted ID]
